items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: my boy Shedrick Mitchell was on organ on a church gig every Sunday. But he was telling me, that’s why I know a lot of these things

ctx.x: I think that’s already changing. Granted, they kicked me out of church in ’99. Footnote, I got kicked out. But thank God, when I was playing in church in Houston when I got a scholarship to come to New York, my pastor in Houston led this church called Brentwood Baptist Church, and my pastor said, “I’m going to call my boy up in Harlem and you’re going to play at his church when you get there.” So I had a good job the first week I got to New York. I got to New York, they put me over to the male chorus first of…

I’ve played with Maxwell for five years, and in 2009 when he came back with “Pretty Wings” and all that stuff, so I did that tour, from ’09 to 2013, and my boy Shedrick Mitchell was on organ on a church gig every Sunday. But he was telling me, that’s why I know a lot of these things because he was like he said, “yeah my pastor — I always sang that stuff — it fascinates people.” But I thought you were going to ask me if I was going to do a Gospel album. Because I am. I’m going to do a Black Radio Gospel album.
Is this the first time you said it anywhere?
